about_the_game:
Welcome to The Barber Shop — an incremental upgrade management simulator where every snip counts.

Your humble, run-down barbershop is about to get a makeover. Invest your hard-earned coins, upgrade your gear, and transform your small-town shop into a sprawling golden parlor worthy of the finest clientele.

Level up your barbers’ skills, keep your customers happy, and deliver the stylish cuts they demand — all while balancing upgrades, marketing, and rent.

With its charming pixel art and simple yet addictive gameplay loop, The Barber Shop offers  2+ hours of satisfying snips and strategic upgrades.

Features

  • Upgrade chairs, tools, and décor to boost your shop’s comfort and appeal

  • Train your barbers for faster, better cuts

  • Manage your time, money, and customers to keep the business thriving

  • Unlock new stations and expand your empire

  • Chill pixel-art visuals with an easy-to-pick-up, hard-to-put-down style

Can you turn your tiny shop into the ultimate hair-cutting empire?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: 2.40 GHz Dual-Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Run your own little barbershop and see if you’ve got what it takes to keep the customers happy and the chairs full! Hire barbers, cut hair, earn tips, and upgrade your shop from a run-down room to a buzzing hotspot.
